findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mcp_server, mcp_changes, annalist_verify_mcp · Private data: smart_perp, checks_service, checks_seller, checks_top, checks_changes, deps_digest, commerce_stores, apis_api, ai_prices, ai_changes, hlp_vault, annalist_verify_service, annalist_track_record · Public sink: crowd_market, smart_perp, web_census · Destructive: annalist_baserates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mcp_server, mcp_changes, annalist_verify_mcp · Private data: smart_perp, checks_service, checks_seller, checks_top, checks_changes, deps_digest, commerce_stores, apis_api, ai_prices, ai_changes, hlp_vault, annalist_verify_service, annalist_track_record · Public sink: crowd_market, smart_perp, web_census · Destructive: annalist_baserates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
